result.summary: Found 2 visual accessibility issues related to low text contrast.

issues.description: The promotional banner uses white headline and subtitle text on a very light mint background. The subtitle is especially difficult to read, making the offer details and checkout code easy to miss.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker text color or a substantially darker banner background/overlay to meet contrast requirements while keeping the promotion legible.

issues.description: The inactive bottom-navigation icons and labels use a very light gray on white, resulting in weak visual contrast compared with the active Home tab.
issues.suggestion: Darken the inactive icon and label color enough to provide clear contrast on the white navigation bar.
